serializer.result: At 0x82CC4F14 r19 is set to zero. A word comparison at 0x82CC4F18 selects the path at threshold ten. Its mode-one and mode-zero branches pass table base as r4 and literal 66 as r3 to 0x822DE4F0 and 0x822DE570 at 0x82CC4F3C and 0x82CC4F64. The other path passes literal 42 and stack +0xA0 instead. At 0x82CC4FAC..0x82CC4FC4 the table is filled with 0xFF over 0x108 bytes; the following loop copies paired words from stack +0xA0/+0xA4 to table +0/+4 using retained offset r19, stepping eight until offset 0xA8.
serializer.qualification: The local reset and paired stores are explicit. The word threshold meaning, buffer helpers and their virtual destinations, input validation, restored values, and runtime save/load remain unresolved. The retained zero offset relies on ordinary nonvolatile-register preservation across the called helpers; their internals were not expanded.

cityMatchRewrite.result: The loop loads each slot +4, compares it to retained r17, and writes retained r21 to +0 only on equality. It steps eight bytes to table base +0x108. Entry 0x82D1AC88/0x82D1AC8C copies incoming r3/r4 into r17/r21.
cityMatchRewrite.qualification: The entry copies and selected loop are checked separately; complete intervening retention, caller policy, and execution phase are not established.

cityMatchRewrite.result: The loop loads each slot +4, compares it to the word at stack +0x154, and writes retained r29 to +0 only on equality. It steps eight bytes to table base +0x108. Entry 0x82D1B41C saves incoming city argument r3 at stack +0x154.
cityMatchRewrite.qualification: The selected owner-store source r29 and complete stack-slot lifetime are not assigned a new-owner meaning. The entry path separately writes the city owner byte at 0x82D1B45C; the intervening join and runtime transfer remain unresolved.

calendarSynchronization.result: The local loop processes three eight-byte slots per iteration and steps 0x18 until table base +0x108. Each lane requires slot owner != -1, positive signed city +3, and signed city owner != -1. It indexes the city table at 0x8314FE28 by slot +4 times 0xBC and rewrites slot +0 with that signed city owner. Separate indexed and +0x20 counters are incremented after each retained lane.
calendarSynchronization.qualification: These are claim-owner synchronization stores, not construction stores or culture/gold credits. Complete preconditions, city-index validation, aggregate meanings, invalid-city cleanup, and runtime execution remain unresolved.

cityWordCounts.result: Each loop starts at table base +0x0C, checks words at -8, 0, and +8 against a retained argument, steps 0x18, and ends at base +0x114. These are the +4 city words of the 33 eight-byte slots. One loop increments a count; the other adds 25 on each equality.
cityWordCounts.qualification: The wider callers and valuation meaning are unassigned. The arithmetic counts existing claim membership; it does not establish a Stonehenge-specific effect or authorize suppressing ordinary Wonder identity.

factorAccumulator.qualification: The selected 0x82CB35B0 base path joins the accepted +0x40 factor accumulation. Its downstream cost and output boundaries remain in the factor manifests. It is not a final culture/gold hook.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only positive base-pair scan capped at 64 emitted 46 candidates without truncation. Forty-six radius-32 windows selected their local uses. Eight radius-64 joins selected writer entries and retained uses. Every raw row matched the supported flat image; exact-function generated windows corroborated selected sequences. Syntactic base pairs do not check intervening writes, execution, or aliases.

guards: Do not infer new completion from first observation of an owned slot or any owner-word change.
Do not suppress claim storage, ordinary ownership counts, construction eligibility, or definition-cost fields to remove an effect.
Do not equate the local serializer helper shapes with verified save/load or an external format.
Do not claim complete computed/aliased consumer or writer coverage from syntactic base pairs.
conclusion: Selected table-base paths expose reset/buffer stores, two city-match owner rewrites, and Calendar claim-owner synchronization beyond the accepted construction helper. Generic city-word counts remain ordinary claim semantics. Completion detection must discriminate those paths; complete effect coverage, lifecycle, cadence, and runtime acceptance remain open.
